ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.4.1 (TieJin Modify) 版本目录：1.6 保留 2.4.1 基线；1.7 为开发测试目录，尚未完成游戏内兼容性验收。两版自动选择各自运行文件，共享基础贴图。 Versioned layout: 1.6 retains the 2.4.1 baseline; 1.7 is a development target awaiting in-game compatibility verification. Each game version loads its own content and shares baseline textures. PNA 重置、欢愉恩赐与绑定维护。 PNA 使用五档负荷与锁链保护下的正面活化，沿用原版成瘾恢复；主人免疫。普通产出者与开启欢愉恩赐的主人可在合格接触后提供补给，并成为成瘾者的来源吸引对象。 主人可在“调教”页开启“欢愉恩赐”，获得“欢愉侵蚀施予者”标记，向合格对象提供 PNA、少量恶堕、身体开发及独立心情与好感反馈；原版 Lovin 不含部位开发。 默认关闭无条件直接选择主人；先使用欲望之种取得永久资格，再在“调教”页选择主人身份。种子可补齐皇权扩展的调教研究蓝图，研究仍需正常完成；载入地图后可在本模组设置手动生成种子。明确保存的直接选择设置继续保留。 修复主从奖励关系与实际锁链归属、解绑与 Character Editor 删除时的清理，补齐四语文本与资源镜像检查。 保留欲望共生四阶段成长、六种特化、调教仪式、自我调教、人格凝胶与身体改造。支持 RimWorld 1.6，基于上游 2.2.8 继续维护。兔入口仍禁用，旧 RimTalk 对接暂停。内容与验证范围见 CHANGELOG.md 和 Docs/Releases/2.4.1/。
Version 2.4.1 — PNA redesign, Bestow Bliss and bond maintenance. Five-stage PNA load and Chain-protected activation use vanilla addiction recovery; Masters are immune. Eligible encounters with ordinary producers or enabled Masters supply PNA and are recognized by addicted observers as supply sources. Enable Bestow Bliss on a Master's Training tab to apply PNA, a small Corruption gain, body-part development and separate mood/opinion feedback to eligible partners. Native Lovin does not grant part development. Direct Master selection now defaults off. Use a Seed of Desire for permanent qualification, then select the Master identity on the Training tab. With Royalty, seeds supply missing Training techprints without completing research. More seeds can be spawned in SSC settings while a map is loaded. Explicitly saved direct-selection settings remain respected. Includes actual-bond reward cleanup, Character Editor removal handling, four-language text and resource mirror validation. Retains Symbiosis of Desire progression, six specializations, Training and Binding Rituals, self-training, Personality Gel and body modification. RimWorld 1.6; continues upstream 2.2.8. Rabbit selection remains disabled and legacy RimTalk remains suspended. See CHANGELOG.md and Docs/Releases/2.4.1/ for scope and verification limits.
